sloka: येषां नोपरि नाधस्तान्न तिर्यक् सज्जते गतिः ।न च कर्मसु सीदन्ति महत्स्वमिततेजसः ।। ५.३९.३६।।।।
transliteration: yeṣāṁ nopari nādhastānna tiryak sajjate gatiḥ ।na ca karmasu sīdanti mahatsvamitatejasaḥ ।। 5.39.36।।।।

translations.english: "Their course cannot be impeded either upward, or downward or right or left. They are indeed very brilliant and would never fail in any task.
